description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I: Vivi], [Fire Resonance +5% Boost], [Dual Veiled Power Mode], [Balefire Pyre Mode] and Faint Beacon +3 to the user

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode I: Vivi
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, grants Bright Beacon +1 to the user after using Fire attacks, causes Faint Beacon -1 to the user after using Fire attacks

description.name: Dual Veiled Power Mode
description.text: Grants [Fire Ability +10% Boost 1]/[Fire Ability +30% Boost 1]/[Fire Ability +50% Boost 1] if the character has Bright Beacon level 1/2/3 after using a Fire ability, removed after triggering three times, removed if the character hasn't [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I: Vivi]

description.name: Balefire Pyre Mode
description.text: Casts Dual Crushing Firaga 1/2/3 times after using Awoken Balefire Pyre (Dual Shift) if the user has Faint Beacon level 0-1/2/3, removed after triggering, removed if the character hasn't [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I: Vivi] or [Dual Awoken Fire Mode II: Vivi]

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Fire Mode II: Vivi], removes [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I: Vivi]
